name: vllm_convert_fp8
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench test_convert_fp8.py. Convert fp16/bf16 to FP8 (uint8 representation): input (M, N) float16/bfloat16, output preallocated uint8 same shape, scale float (0.5 or 1.0), kv_dtype string ('fp8'). Reference mutates output via vLLM _custom_ops.convert_fp8 and returns it. Workloads use scale=1.0, kv_dtype='fp8' hardcoded. Output uint8 → exact comparison. Requires vLLM at eval time.
